text:
elaine_support: heads up — ACME reported their console hourly usage dropped to 0 for the past 3 hours after our auth key rotation at ~01:02 UTC. customer on a call. ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/t/4567. saw spikes of ETL failures in the logs.

kenny_eng: looking. can you paste the exact error from the ETL job?

elaine_support: from orchestration logs: ```
2026-03-16T01:04:12Z ERROR etl-worker-12 write failed status=403 auth="AccessDenied" tenant=acme
```
also saw repeated consumer retries & backoff.

marta_sre: that 403 matches the auth-rotation window — deploybot shows we rolled a new role/policy at 01:02. likely the ETL service didn't pick up new creds and started failing writes to S3. did we forget to restart the daemonset that fetches the role? :eyes: 

jason_analytics: consumer offsets show messages stuck since 01:03, backlog ~= 120k events. ETL worker crashed with `s3.putObject -> 403`. rough ETA to catch up if we restart is ~45m at current parallelism.

kenny_eng: quick mitigations: 1) re-run ETL pinned to old creds (unsafe), 2) grant temporary role to `etl-service-account` and restart consumers (preferred). marta, can you open a temp IAM policy?

marta_sre: creating temp policy now, will attach to `etl-service` in prod-analytics. pinging infra for a fast bind. :hammer_and_wrench:

deploybot: auth-rotation job completed: job_id=rot-20260316-01, changed role-policy on account-prod, triggered config-rollout to private agents.

elaine_support: customer is pressing for ETA. can someone confirm backfill start + ETA for console visibility?

marta_sre: policy attached and I restarted the `etl-consumers` k8s deployment (replicas=8) at 01:22. starting catch-up now. sample progress: ```
2026-03-16T01:30:12Z INFO processed 0->24000 in 8m
``` estimating ~30-50m remaining depending on parallelism.

jason_analytics: kicked off a manual backfill for missed hourly windows (01:00-04:00) — will update dashboard after rollups finish. also opening an internal ticket to run a historical integrity backfill if counts don't match.

kenny_eng: once backfill completes, run this integrity check: `SELECT count(*) FROM hourly_rollups WHERE tenant = 'acme' AND hour >= '2026-03-16T01:00'`. if mismatch, escalate to infra for a fuller replay.

elaine_support: thanks all — i'll update the customer and keep monitoring. :thumbsup:
